admin.account.roles.confirm_grant.descri.defaultMessage: The account's user gets the role's permissions from their next request. You can revoke it later.
admin.account.roles.confirm_grant.descri.description: Description of the confirmation of granting a role.

admin.account.roles.confirm_grant.title.description: Title of the confirmation of granting a role; role is its key, handle the account's @handle.

admin.account.roles.confirm_revoke.descr.description: Description of the confirmation of revoking a role other than admin.

admin.account.roles.confirm_revoke.descr.description: Description of the confirmation of revoking the admin role.

admin.account.roles.confirm_revoke.title.description: Title of the confirmation of revoking a role; role is its key, handle the account's @handle.

admin.account.roles.description.defaultMessage: Roles give the account's user the permissions of the admin screens. You can grant and revoke the roles at or below your highest role. The audit log records each change.

admin.account.roles.empty.description: Heading when the instance has no roles at all.

admin.account.roles.failed.defaultMessage: The role could not be changed: {reason}
admin.account.roles.failed.description: Error in the confirmation of a role change; reason is the server's localized message.

admin.account.roles.failed.last_admin.defaultMessage: The role could not be revoked: this account is the only admin of this server. Grant admin to another account first.
admin.account.roles.failed.last_admin.description: Error in the confirmation of revoking admin that the server refused because the account is the only admin.

admin.account.roles.failed.outranked.defaultMessage: The role could not be changed: it is above your highest role, or it has permissions you do not hold. You can grant and revoke only the roles at or below your highest role, and grant only roles whose permissions you all hold.

admin.account.two_factor.on.defaultMessage: On: signing in asks for a code from an authenticator app.
admin.account.two_factor.on.description: Text while the account's user has two-factor authentication.

admin.account.two_factor.remove.descript.description: Explanation above the button that removes the two-factor authentication of an account.

admin.account.two_factor.confirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation of removing the two-factor authentication. {handle} is the account's handle.

admin.account.two_factor.confirm.descrip.defaultMessage: They will sign in with their password alone until they set it up again. This cannot be undone.
admin.account.two_factor.confirm.descrip.description: Body of the confirmation of removing the two-factor authentication.

admin.account.two_factor.removed.description: Status message after removing the two-factor authentication of the account {handle}.

admin.account.password_reset.title.description: Heading of the region of a local account's admin page about issuing a password reset link.

admin.account.password_reset.description.defaultMessage: Issues a link that sets a new password for this user, to hand to them when email does not reach them. The link works once, for an hour. Anyone who has it can set the password: confirm who is asking through another channel first, and give it to the account's owner only. The issuance is recorded in the audit log.
admin.account.password_reset.description.description: Explanation above the button that issues a password reset link for an account.

admin.account.password_reset.issue.description: Button (and the confirmation's button) that issues a password reset link for the account.

admin.account.password_reset.confirm.tit.defaultMessage: Issue a password reset link for {handle}?
admin.account.password_reset.confirm.tit.description: Title of the confirmation of issuing a password reset link. {handle} is the account's handle.

admin.account.password_reset.confirm.des.defaultMessage: The link is shown only once, here. It does not change the password until someone opens it and sets a new one.
admin.account.password_reset.confirm.des.description: Body of the confirmation of issuing a password reset link.

admin.account.password_reset.issued.defaultMessage: Issued a password reset link for {handle}.
admin.account.password_reset.issued.description: Status message after issuing a password reset link for the account {handle}.

admin.account.password_reset.failed.description: Error in the confirmation when issuing the link failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

admin.account.password_reset.link.description: Label of the password reset link that was just issued.

admin.account.password_reset.link.notice.defaultMessage: This link is not shown again. It works once, until {expiresAt}.
admin.account.password_reset.link.notice.description: Note under the label of the issued link. {expiresAt} is the formatted date and time when the link stops working.

admin.account.password_reset.copy.description: Button that copies the issued password reset link to the clipboard.

admin.account.password_reset.copied.description: Toast after copying the password reset link.

admin.account.password_reset.copy_failed.description: Toast when copying the password reset link failed.

admin.account.email_suppression.hard_bou.defaultMessage: Emails do not reach this address: an email to it bounced. The server sends it nothing except a verification email that the user asks for.
admin.account.email_suppression.hard_bou.description: Text while the account's primary address is suppressed after a hard bounce.

admin.account.email_suppression.complain.defaultMessage: The recipient marked an email as spam. The server sends no more notification emails, but still sends the ones needed to sign in and keep the account safe.
admin.account.email_suppression.complain.description: Text while the account's primary address is suppressed after a spam complaint.

admin.account.email_suppression.since.description: When the suppression started. {since} is a formatted date and time.

admin.account.email_suppression.lift.des.description: Explanation above the button that lifts the email suppression. The lift is recorded in the audit log.

admin.account.email_suppression.confirm..description: Title of the confirmation of lifting the email suppression. {handle} is the account's handle.

admin.account.email_suppression.confirm..defaultMessage: The server will send email to this address again.
admin.account.email_suppression.confirm..description: Body of the confirmation of lifting the email suppression.

admin.account.email_suppression.lifted.description: Status message after lifting the email suppression of the account {handle}.

admin.account.email_suppression.failed.description: Error in the confirmation when the lift failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.
